## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/Release
- [ ] Security

## Validation

- [ ] `cd backend && go test ./...`
- [ ] `cd app && npm ci && npm run build`
- [ ] Tested manually in app (if UI/runtime behavior changed)

## Risk / Impact

Describe potential regressions and impacted areas.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change scoped and reviewed related code paths.
- [ ] I updated docs (`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, etc.) if behavior changed.
- [ ] I considered security implications for new endpoints, storage, or execution paths.
- [ ] I verified release/version behavior if this affects packaging or workflows.
